references.notes: Was printed as 'PROVE study investigators' with a paraphrased title. The study used an earlier CLIA-waived Visby Sexual Health Test, not the OTC Women's test; 78.8% is chlamydia only; the 100% positive accuracy is from the separate 28-person PALESA study. The discussion also mentions 'the few false positive results observed' in PALESA, which sits uneasily with the reported 100%; the page reports only what the authors state and notes negatives were not checked.
